growthGuide.meta_description: Find out which stage your business is in today, and the one specific move that gets you to profit and stability.
growthGuide.hero_headline: Don't let operational chaos and swinging sales stall your company's growth
growthGuide.hero_subheadline: Download the free Company Growth Assessment Guide and find out which stage your business is in today, and the specific step that gets you to profit and stability.
growthGuide.cover_subtitle: The 5 growth stages + a practical checklist
growthGuide.problems_title: Is your company facing any of these today?
growthGuide.problem_cashflow_body: Strong sales one month, a sharp drop the next, with no clear reason.
growthGuide.problem_margins_body: Excellent revenue, yet no real net profit at the end of the month.
growthGuide.problem_system_body: Without clear follow-up policies, staff performance depends on mood.
growthGuide.problem_brand_body: Lower-quality competitors take more share because you have no clear story.
growthGuide.value_title: What will you discover inside this practical guide?
growthGuide.value_diagnose_title: A precise diagnosis of your stage
growthGuide.value_diagnose_body: Learn the 5 stages of company growth and pinpoint exactly where you are.
growthGuide.value_checklist_body: Quick assessment points that reveal the gaps in your team and systems.
growthGuide.value_roadmap_body: Know the right strategic decision for your stage: fix sales, raise profit, or build systems.
growthGuide.value_focus_body: Focus only on the solution you need, and avoid the wrong fix at the wrong time.
growthGuide.guide_title: We understand the weight on your shoulders
growthGuide.guide_empathy: Running a business is not just numbers — it is daily effort and constant pressure. We know how it feels to give it everything and still find the company depends on you for every small thing.
growthGuide.authority_consulting_body: Helped dozens of companies move from chaos to systems.
growthGuide.authority_sales_body: Tailored strategies that lift team efficiency and cash flow.
growthGuide.authority_solutions_body: Preparing leaders and building marketing and sales structures.
growthGuide.plan_title: 3 simple steps to take your company to the next stage
growthGuide.plan_one_body: Get the PDF and run a quick assessment of your company with the checklist.
growthGuide.plan_two_body: We review your results together in a free 30-minute call and identify the operational gaps.
growthGuide.plan_three_body: We put the right systems and training in place so your company moves toward stability and profit.

admin_marketing.h_gtm: Container id. When set, GA4 and other tags are managed inside GTM.
admin_marketing.h_ga4: Loaded directly only when GTM is empty (avoids double counting).
admin_marketing.h_clarity: Project id — heatmaps and session recordings.
admin_marketing.h_pixel: Enables PageView plus Lead/Registration/Purchase events in the browser.
admin_marketing.h_meta_domain: Content of the facebook-domain-verification tag from Business Manager.
admin_marketing.h_capi: Stored server-side only and never displayed. Sends Lead, Registration and Purchase from the server to bypass iOS blocking.
admin_marketing.h_notify: Every new lead is emailed immediately to these addresses (comma-separated).
admin_marketing.h_popup: Shows on exit intent (or after 45s on mobile) to signed-out visitors, once a week.
